system.description: You've been secretly leaking information about your allies (usually your own coterie) through a designated drop point, and if other Nosferatu find out, they will kill you on sight. You must betray a secret about your allies every game session, whether through regular messages, a hidden drop, or a courier package. At the end of the session, you must tell the Storyteller what you've done; if you haven't been enough of a bastard, one of your secrets winds up on the local information network anyway.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
